recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open-source wizards rebuilding a classic turn-based strategy engine from scratch
living room screens running tiny vision models frame by frame
DNS switches waiting on the edge of the internet
clear autumn night over San Francisco, ten degrees and still
agents spun up from a phone shortcut before sunrise
election day energy rippling through distant cities

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap to summon hero units onto hex tiles before the enemy AI finishes its turn — every successful placement shifts the battle line one tile closer to victory.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: tap to place units on a shrinking hex grid
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: watching the enemy flank collapse in one decisive chain
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fewer empty hexes, faster enemy turns, special units appear mid-round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: parchment map with ink-wash fantasy units

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold to charge a privacy shield that blocks pixel-tracking beams sweeping across your phone screen — release between sweeps to stay invisible.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: last-second dodge when a scan beam almost catches you
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beams multiply, sweep faster, safe windows shrink
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe phone UI with red detection rays

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe to redirect DNS query packets through a maze of routers before temporary blocks seal off platform routes — route the last packet through a closing gap.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: snapping the final packet through a gate milliseconds before it slams shut
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: more blocked routes, packets fork into decoys, decision window narrows
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: matrix-green network topology on dark void

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves into color-matched wind currents on a San Francisco hillside — wrong current and the gust blows your streak away.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: physics flick into matching wind currents
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: perfect ricochet when a leaf spirals into the golden pile
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind shifts direction, decoy leaves fall, currents narrow and speed up
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout autumn hillside with drifting fog bands
